rule: Members agree to abide by these rules, which supplement the rules enforced by Sleeper.
12-person Super Flex league.
notes: 12 teams passed 2025; Superflex first passed 2022. Sleeper shows 2 SUPER_FLEX slots.

rule: Scoring is Tiered PPR with 0.5 PPFD.
notes: 0.5 first downs passed 2024. Sleeper scores a flat 1.0 per reception via yardage tiers (0+ yds = 1), i.e. full PPR since 2021.

rule: Champion: 60%.
Runner-up: 20%.
3rd place game winner: 10%.
First place regular season: 10%.
notes: Buy-in raised to $120 in 2019.

rule: Each manager must start a minimum of 5 players per week.
notes: Not on the suggestions sheet.

rule: Managers may not start a player grandfathered into a position he is no longer eligible for.
notes: 2020 vote also lets the commissioner edit such lineups.

rule: No transactions once a manager is eliminated from Playoff/Sacko contention.
notes: Passed 2022 (3rd place counts as a league award).

rule: All trades auto-process.
Managers may not veto trades they are a participant in.
A majority vote of the remaining managers is required to veto a trade.
The league does not vote on or enforce trades with multiple transactions; each trade proposed in Sleeper is voted on separately.
1st and 2nd seeds get a bye.
notes: Format history: 15 weeks / 4 teams (2020), then 5 teams with a 3-team final for 2 seasons, now 14 weeks / 6 teams with 12 teams (2025). Sleeper: 6 playoff teams, start Week 15.

rule: The 3rd seed picks between the 5th and 6th seeds as the first-round opponent.
The pick must be made by Tuesday night before Week 16 so teams can submit waiver claims.
Sacko is a Toilet Bowl tournament among the 6 lowest teams, mirroring the playoff seeding.
notes: Sacko bracket history: 2020, 2022, 2025.

rule: Unless Sacko is decided outright by a 31+ Rumble deficit to 9th place at the end of the regular season.
notes: Threshold was 36 before the 2025 change; the 2022 proposal to cut 37 to 29 failed.

rule: Off-season rule changes pass by simple majority.
In-season rule changes need a 10 or 11 of 12 "mega-majority".
notes: Originally 9/10 support in 2019.

rule: The new season officially begins after the league dinner.
Raise buy-in to $120
Announce all approved changes on draft day
Forced fumble worth 1 point, fumble recovery worth 1 point
notes: Sleeper now: D/ST forced fumble 1, fumble recovery 1; player forced fumble 0.5, player fumble recovery 1.5
